modules.title: Carry-on
modules.lede: Hand baggage and a personal item are free; the number of hand bags depends on class and destination.

carryon_bag_dimensions.value: Hand baggage up to 55 x 40 x 25 cm / 22 x 16 x 10 in.

carryon_weight.value: Hand baggage up to 10 kg / 22 lbs per item.

personal_item.value: 1 personal item up to 40 x 30 x 15 cm / 16 x 12 x 5 in and 2 kg / 4.4 lbs; it must fit under the seat in front.

items_by_class.value: Economy and Economy Prime: 1 item of hand baggage. Business to/from North America: 1 item. Business to/from Europe, Africa, South America or on domestic flights: 2 items.

piece_weight_economy.notes: TAP Air Portugal Economy Class checked baggage allowance.

piece_weight_business.value: 2 pieces up to 32 kg (70 lbs) each
piece_weight_business.notes: TAP Air Portugal Business Class checked baggage allowance.

piece_weight_first.value: 3 pieces up to 32 kg (70 lbs) each
piece_weight_first.notes: TAP Air Portugal First Class checked baggage allowance.

modules.title: Check-in and airport cutoffs
modules.lede: Counter opening times and check-in deadlines depend on the departure airport; TAP publishes them airport by airport.

online_checkin.value: Online on flytap.com or the TAP app from 36 hours before boarding, or 24 hours for flights to or from the USA.

gate_deadline.value: Whatever check-in method you use, be at the boarding gate at least 30 minutes before scheduled departure.

phone_home_market.notes: TAP Air Portugal official customer support line.
